scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p e2e/tsconfig.json && pnpm -r --no-bail typecheck
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm scan
scripts.relay:telemetry-off: pnpm dlx wrangler@4.147.0 telemetry disable --config services/relay/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.relay:create-storage: pnpm dlx wrangler@4.147.0 kv namespace create RELAY_KV --config services/relay/wrangler.jsonc --no-update-config
scripts.relay:create-test-storage: pnpm dlx wrangler@4.147.0 kv namespace create RELAY_KV --config services/relay/wrangler.jsonc --env test --no-update-config
scripts.relay:list-storage: pnpm dlx wrangler@4.147.0 kv namespace list --config services/relay/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.relay:deploy-test: node tools/relay/deploy-check.ts test && pnpm dlx wrangler@4.147.0 deploy --config services/relay/wrangler.jsonc --env test
scripts.relay:deploy: node tools/relay/deploy-check.ts production && pnpm dlx wrangler@4.147.0 deploy --config services/relay/wrangler.jsonc --env=
scripts.relay:dry-run: pnpm dlx wrangler@4.147.0 deploy --config services/relay/wrangler.jsonc --env= --dry-run --outdir services/relay/.wrangler/dry-run
